children: Cingulate's net loss widened 5.3% year over year, as higher drug manufacturing costs following the FDA's request for additional CMC information and increased commercial-readiness spending were partly offset by lower clinical operations and regulatory costs.
² Reported as “Net loss and comprehensive loss”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per share of common stock, basic and diluted”.
: CMC work to address the FDA's Complete Response Letter requests was substantially completed; the company expects to resubmit between December 2026 and January 2027.
: SG&A expenses rose 45.5%, primarily reflecting launch planning, increased headcount and expanded market access, pricing, reimbursement and medical affairs activities.
: Research and development expenses increased 2.2%, driven mainly by higher drug manufacturing costs, partly offset by lower clinical operations and regulatory costs.
: Cingulate signed an exclusive services agreement with Prasco to establish commercial distribution infrastructure for a potential CTx-1301 launch.
